says: In next/, the P15 reload laws boot a real Project over node:sqlite in every case, yet each runs a fixed 50 or 100 cases on every pull request, passed as a plain argument to the file's `law` helper, so decision 0535's depth cut never reaches them and runs-from-depth cannot see it.
proof: reload.laws.test.ts opens `new DatabaseSync(":memory:")` in `instance` (line 145) and its `law(body, runs)` helper hands `runs` to `fc.assert` (line 469); the calls pass 100 at lines 662, 866, 930, 1081 and 1137 and 50 at 794, 1184, 1204 and 1256. oxlint-plugins/runs-from-depth.ts says in its header that it cannot see a count passed as a plain argument to a helper.
cost: Each pull request that touches libfabrika runs those laws at their full count, the CI time 0535 set out to cut, and the lint rule reports the file clean.
